header.notSaved: This choice applies on this device, but it wasn't saved to your account.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.empty: No time zone matches your search.

brand.title: Welcome
brand.lead: Before you start, set the basics: what to call you, how you like to see dates and times, and the Space where you will work.
brand.later: You can change any of this later in Account.

profile.title: Your name
profile.description: This is how people in your Space will see you.
profile.name: Name

preferences.title: Your preferences
preferences.description: These come from your browser. Check them and adjust if needed.

space.title: Your Space
space.description: This is where you will work in the app. Choose its name and address.
space.name: Space name
space.slugHint: It appears in the Space's link. Use lowercase letters without accents, numbers and hyphens.
space.inviteTitle: An invitation is waiting for you
space.inviteDescription: You have an invitation to join the Space {name}. When you finish, you become part of it.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: This is how people see you in the app.
profile.name: Name

avatar.label: Photo
avatar.hint: Use a JPG or PNG image.

preferencesPage.title: Preferences
preferencesPage.description: Language, theme, time zone and how dates and names appear. Language and theme change as soon as you pick them; save to bring your choice to your other devices.
preferencesPage.loadFailed: Your preferences couldn't be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

password.title: Password
password.description: To change your password, you get a code by e-mail and choose the new password on the sign-in page.
password.provider: Your account has no password in this app. If you sign in with Google or GitHub, the password is that service's and changes there.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.enabledDescription: On. When you sign in on a new device or browser, you also enter a code from your authenticator app.
mfa.disabledDescription: Ask for a code from your authenticator app on top of your password when you sign in.

disableConfirm.title: Turn off two-factor authentication
disableConfirm.description: Only your password will be asked when you sign in. You can turn it on again whenever you want.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Deletes your account, credentials and profile for good. This can't be undone.
danger.confirmBody: This deletes your credentials, your open sessions and your profile for good. Spaces you don't own stay as they are. If you are the only owner of a Space with other people, remove them or hand over ownership first.

email.title: E-mail
email.description: The address you sign in with and where the app's notices go.
email.statusFailed: Your account's e-mail and password details couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.

pendingWarning.title: Pending invitations and purchases stay on the current address
pendingWarning.description: Space invitations and unclaimed purchases sent to the current e-mail don't move to the new one. After the change, ask whoever sent them to send them again.

email.newEmailHelp: One code goes to the current e-mail and another to the new one. Both confirm the change.
email.invalidEmail: Enter a full e-mail address, with a name and a domain separated by an at sign.
email.codesSent: One code was sent to {current} and another to {next}. Enter both to confirm the change.
email.codeFormat: Enter the code from the e-mail, digits only.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: The devices and browsers where your account is open. End the ones you don't recognize.

revokeConfirm.title: End the session {device}
revokeConfirm.description: Whoever is using that device will have to sign in again.

signOutOthersConfirm.title: Sign out of other sessions
signOutOthersConfirm.description: The other devices and browsers will have to sign in again. This session stays open.

sessions.signedOutOthers: No other session was open. | One other session was ended. | {count} other sessions were ended.

errors.slug_taken: Another Space already uses this address. Choose a different one.
errors.slug_reserved: This address is reserved by the app. Choose a different one.
errors.slug_invalid: The address can use only lowercase letters without accents, numbers and hyphens. Adjust it and try again.
errors.email_taken: This email already belongs to another account. Use a different address.
errors.email_unchanged: This is already your current email. Enter the new address you want to use.
errors.email_managed_by_provider: Your email comes from the Google or GitHub account you sign in with, so it can't be changed here. Change it in that service instead.
errors.invalid_code: That code doesn't match. Copy the code from the most recent email and try again.
errors.code_expired: This code has expired. Request the change again to get new codes.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.invalid_time_zone: This time zone isn't recognized. Pick one from the list.
errors.invalid_locale: This language isn't available. Choose English, Portuguese or Spanish.
errors.invalid_theme: This theme isn't available. Choose system, light or dark.
errors.invalid_date_format: This date format isn't available. Pick one from the list.
errors.invalid_name_order: This name order isn't available. Pick one from the list.
errors.invite_unavailable: This invitation is no longer valid: it expired, was canceled or was already used. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
errors.generic: The action couldn't be completed. Try again in a moment.
errors.cannot_revoke_current_session: This is the session you are using now. To end it, sign out.
